connect.q: How do I connect my pages and profiles?
connect.a: After signing up, open Channels and pick a network. Facebook and Instagram connect with your Facebook login; other networks ask for their own sign-in.

schedule.a: Write a post once, pick the channels and a time, or add it to a channel’s queue. The app publishes it at that time, even when nobody is signed in.

networks.a: Facebook Pages and Groups, Instagram, Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Threads, X, Pinterest, Telegram, YouTube and TikTok, depending on what the installation has switched on.

team.a: Yes. Invite teammates with a role (admin, editor, contributor, viewer) and choose which channels each one can use.

clients.a: Send an approval link: the client sees the post and approves or asks for changes without creating an account.

analytics.q: Where do the numbers come from?
analytics.a: Straight from each network’s API, read regularly in the background and kept so history stays available.

data.q: How do I get my data out or delete it?
data.a: Workspace owners can export everything as a ZIP from Settings. The data deletion page explains how to remove an account.
